metadata.description: Simulates the AI-assistant retrieval pipeline (reach -> render -> extract -> retrieve -> cite -> arrive) and reports the exact stage where a brand falls out, artifact-backed and falsified before it ships.

plugins.name: brand-ai-readiness-audit
plugins.description: Audits a website's visibility to AI assistants by simulating the retrieval pipeline stage by stage. Invoke ai-visibility-orchestrator directly -- the other seven skills are internal pipeline stages it drives via scripts/run_audit.py, not independent entry points.
